column1: # Project roots. Each depth-1 directory under a root becomes a session named
# <kind>/<basename>. The kind prefix is what keeps colliding basenames apart:
# algebraic-geometry exists under both textbooks trees.
# Paths may contain spaces; only the ends are trimmed.
# FROZEN. $TEXTBOOKS (~/Documents/academic/textbooks) is not to be edited; the
# BACKUP tree above is the working copy. Kept here so it is still reachable,
# under a kind that makes the session name say so: tbf/<subject>.
